description: North infill (task H, author 10 October 2026): buildings on the author's 1891-96 OS footprints in the core area north of the G.E.R. main line and east of the Old River Lea (x > -1380; Stratford Marsh: Carpenters Road, Warton Road and Marshgate Lane, traced for this batch from the OS five-foot plan) that the scene did not model. The 14 factory sites earlier excluded as "North of the Great Eastern Main Line" are added here, except the Hair & Wool Works. Not in this batch: the land between the Old River Lea and the Lee Navigation (Bow goods yard, Hair & Wool Works) and the Old Ford / Hackney Wick strip west of the Navigation (factory sites with the streets they front onto), the housing there, and the Great Eastern works at Stratford (north of the core).
method: Same audit and typology as the task F core infill (data/maps/core-infill-selection.json): footprints of 30 m² and over with under 10% of their area modelled (1 m tolerance) in the author's london_buildings_1891-96_corr_v1.gpkg; sites from the Industry_1893-95 polygons; scattered buildings grouped by nearest street into context sites 93xx (model groupings, not parcels). Held back: any footprint with more than 2 m² inside a traced road corridor or over the drawn water. Storeys, materials and uses are typological estimates by size and position; 300 m² and over flagged for individual reading. Tools: main checkout reference/task-e-tools/infill/.
